\section[il grattacielo]{il grattacielo — a skyscraper}

\label{lesson:IT-C228-grattacielo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Italian for luggage, then the Italian for a place, a seat.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: il grattacielo}
\textbf{il grattacielo} — \textquotedblleft{}a skyscraper\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{grattacielo} is \emph{gratta}, \textquotedblleft{}it scratches\textquotedblright{}, plus \emph{cielo}, \textquotedblleft{}sky\textquotedblright{}, after English \emph{skyscraper}. EtymDB 2.1 has no row for it; the parts are plain to see.
\end{cousinweb}

\end{cousinweb}
